scope: public architecture and runtime resource contracts
isolationRules: Retired identities cannot appear in first-level navigation.
Retired identities cannot be targets in cross-surface reference contracts.
Legacy content files may remain only as hidden migration sources until final deletion.
Carrier paths do not inherit their former public identity: /church/ is LivingWaterWest, /journal/ is Magazine, /one/ is Emmaus.
Video and Podcast may exist only as media/source metadata, never as product or ownership surfaces.
Website cannot be used as a catch-all destination or resource owner.
No future architecture contract may depend on legacy layout, CSS, template or component structure.
deletionPolicy: Do not delete hidden legacy source files until route/build/resource validation passes; after validation they may be removed if no compatibility requirement remains.
